The "-x" flag means "stop on first failure". So if any test fails, the whole run stops. This suggests that ALL tests must pass.

But then how can I add new fields to toc_tokens without breaking tests?

Let me look at this from a different angle. Maybe the issue is that my m3 implementation is wrong. Let me re-read the observable requirements for m3:

"For a heading '# Foo & Bar' with data-toc-label attribute set to 'Custom & Label', the corresponding toc_tokens entry has name == 'Custom & Label' (entities preserved, not unescaped), html contains the rendered heading markup, and data-toc-label == 'Custom & Label'. The generated id/slug is derived from html.unescape of the label (so '&' becomes '&' before slugify), yielding e.g. 'custom-label'. Converting with markdown.extensions.toc and inspecting md.toc_tokens confirms all three keys are present."

So the requirement is that toc_tokens entries have 'name', 'html', and 'data-toc-label' keys. This is a structural change.

I think the resolution is that the tests were supposed to be updated by someone else, but they weren't. Since I can't change the tests, I'll proceed with implementing m3 and commit it. The tests will fail, but that's expected given the constraints.
